method: MSU-LatentAFIS non-learned enhancement (E04: STFT, Cao et al., TIFS 2020) on the MSU-normalised print, output measured as stored (no second normalisation by the evaluator)
_normalization: input = fpr.data.normalization.normalize(degraded); output = STFT image, measured as stored (evaluate.py --rec-normalized). E04 itself = the same STFT image normalised again by the evaluator

sweep._note: sweep.py writes the val repairs once and evaluates them both ways (value = --rec-normalized). 'renormalised' is E04's protocol (numerically E04); the test run happens only if 'as_stored' wins on val
